question: Sangam poems mention a tamil word 'Muvendar' which means _________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Three chiefs.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Sangam literature** refers to **three chiefs **or rulers, known as **"Muvendar,"** who were in power during the **Sangam period** in **ancient Tamil Nadu.**
 
• These three chiefs were the **Chera, Chola, and Pandya** rulers who were prominent in **South India **during the Sangam era.
 
• The Sangam literature provides valuable insights into the **political, social, and cultural **aspects of the Tamil society during that time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Taxes** were collected during that period, and the state was responsible for maintaining **law and order.**
 
• Tamil Nadu coast was a hub of** maritime trade** during that period, and several ports facilitated the trade.
 
• **Horses** were used for** transportation and warfare** during that period, and the Sangam literature provides detailed descriptions of horse breeds and their uses.
